title: Dept 56 flying santa
text: Dept 56 flying santa. Sadly this worked about twice and then got "stuck" in one position. Disappointing to say the least.  But it fit so nicely above my Dept 56 ornament size village that I just took it apart and glued it the position I liked.  For the money, I was disappointed in the quality, but made it work for me and didn't return it.  I would not purchase again.
